claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond the frozen finite windows
release while the callback remains blocked
task effect after recovery (the frozen effect precedes the cancellation point)

decision.fail_or_unknown: Preserve FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN if the callback entry, ordering, exact producer retirement, public recovered receipt, independent same-generation post-callback Q-up, exact effect, or cleanup is missing; if release remains unknown; or if emergency Q-up is needed. No retry. A Q-up sample before callback return is not release evidence.
decision.pass: Exactly one public dispatch and one public cancel. The callback remains held for the frozen 250ms post-cancel window and forwards the original injected Q-down on return. The exact producer retires, public cancellation reports recovered with release_confirmed=true within 3500ms, and an independent same-generation readback reports Q-up after callback return and before any emergency cleanup. The exact R22 fixture effect and fixture/hook/foreground cleanup are verified. Any emergency Q-up is cleanup-only and disqualifies product recovery PASS.

environment.windows: Windows 11 Pro build 26300; LowLevelHooksTimeout not configured (read-only).

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: For one standard public Win32 MCP action canceled while the owned low-level hook holds the injected Q-down for a bounded 250ms after cancel, the caller can retire the exact producer, complete same-generation recovery and independently prove Q-up after callback return within 3500ms, while preserving an independently checked pre-cancel fixture effect.
resource_boundary: Only the user-authorized local Windows PC and one owned fixture process/window; one public dispatch and one cancel; one injected Q-down held at most 2000ms by fail-safe and released by the probe after a 250ms post-cancel window. No WSLc, Docker, other application windows, registry changes, replay, or retry. Emergency Q-up is attempted only after exact producer retirement, same-generation confirmation, and fixture foreground confirmation; it is cleanup-only.
retry_policy: one validation and at most one public dispatch; retrieve its call ID from the zero-wait response; issue one cancel only after hook entry and a same-call running readback; no fallback input, replay, retry, or rerun

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: Fixture click, sentinel text, and CTRL+S save precede the Q-down cancellation point. The exact fixture effect is checked independently; runtime task_success remains null.

native_stimulus.event: first injected VK_Q WM_KEYDOWN only; after the 250ms post-cancel hold, forward it normally
native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: Retain the exact callback for up to 250ms after the single public cancel, then forward the original Q-down through CallNextHookEx; the callback has a 2000ms fail-safe bound.

trial.pre_cancel_readback: After hook entry, interface_results must show action status running before one interface_cancel call.
trial.target: one fresh owned fixture process/window; exact call_id obtained from the public zero-wait pending-or-terminal dispatch response
